title: EgoAnchor 中文系统架构图
keyClaimsRepresented: Python only emits camera-space object pose and reliability, not Unity world anchors.
Unity reconstructs the world anchor through exact frame_id lookup of the capture-time camera world pose.
ZMQ data plane, NATS message plane, and NATS command plane are visually separated.
StaticLockController is represented as a score-gated regime switch, not a low-pass filter.
EgoAnchor_Tools3 is placed in the offline evaluation support band, not in the online runtime path.
